scope: Current polling arrays for all 506 House, Senate, and Governor race IDs in public/data/race-retrospectives.json. Historical-cycle poll archives were not modified.

audit.repeated_poll_id_note: No repeated-ID group consisted of identical full records; repeated IDs were retained unless a cross-source duplicate result was matched, because a poll can have multiple ballot outcomes.

deduplication_rule: Remove one copy only when the same race, field dates, sample, population, pollster family, and effectively identical result (within 0.15 pp) matched uniquely across source systems. Preserve separate ballot outcomes within a survey.

alaska_siena_conflict_and_correction.reason: Same NYT/Siena survey and sample (504), same field end, differing feed start date/margin. The RealClearPolling listing reports 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-01 and Kreiss-Tompkins 52, Wilson 48 (+4); retain the NYT-linked record, align its date and margin, and remove the second copy.

reviewed_but_retained: The Tennessee House District 9 same-date/same-sample overlap between Hart Research and Public Opinion Strategies was retained because pollster identities differ and the available records do not establish that they are one survey. Other same-poll multi-question/RCV outcomes were retained.
predictions_unchanged: No race forecast margins, probabilities, seat distributions, models, gating, or source cutoff values were modified.
